_mock_note: Hand-written mock for contract section 5. Sample returns by resampling real historical annual returns with replacement, not from a normal distribution - real returns have fatter tails, so a bell curve quietly overstates the success probability, and resampling is also what captures sequence risk. successful_simulations and p10_gap_to_goal exist because the Explanation Agent needs to say '8,700 of 10,000' and 'falls 3,50,000 short' and is not allowed to calculate either itself.
